test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A car has to cover a distance of 288 km in 20 hours. If it covers half of the journey in 1/5th of the time, find the speed to cover the remaining distance in the time left.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Remaining Distance** = 288 ÷ 2 = 144 km.

**Remaining Time** = 20 × (1 − 1/5) = 20 × 4/5 = 16 hours.

**Required Speed** = 144 ÷ 16 = 9 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce5223a53e9acd4801e6f864f6f3ebb290c2cccbb59ed6065d07ec756c8cf82c.png] 

**Given:** Total **Distance** = 288 km, Total **Time** = 20 hours.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ **First half distance** = 288 ÷ 2 = 144 km.

⇒ **Remaining distance** = 288 − 144 = 144 km.

⇒ **Time taken for first half** = 1/5 × 20 = 4 hours.

⇒ **Remaining time** = 20 − 4 = 16 hours.

⇒ **Speed for remaining journey** = 144 ÷ 16 = 9 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

When a journey is divided into parts, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Conversion of Speed Units

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
